sections.heading: 1.0.1 Welcome to the Cisco NetAcad Python Journey
sections.content:
Welcome to Python Essentials 1! This course has been engineered in partnership between the Cisco Networking Academy and the OpenEDG Python Institute to take you from complete beginner to confident, certified Python programmer.

Python has grown to become the world's most popular programming language across web development, data science, artificial intelligence, cloud automation, and network engineering. Its clean, readable syntax allows you to express powerful computational concepts with clarity and brevity.

Throughout this course, you will not simply memorize syntax rules. You will learn HOW computer programs execute, HOW memory is allocated, and HOW to write maintainable, production-ready code that adheres to industry standards.

sections.heading: 1.0.2 Curriculum Structure & Module Roadmap
sections.content:
Python Essentials 1 is organized into four rigorous, hands-on modules:

• Module 1: Introduction to Python and Computer Programming — Understand computer architecture, machine code, compilation vs. interpretation, and the CPython execution pipeline.
• Module 2: Data Types, Variables, Basic I/O, and Operators — Master Python literals, arithmetic operations, operator precedence, type conversions, and formatted console interaction.
• Module 3: Boolean Values, Conditional Execution, Loops, Lists, and Bitwise Logic — Construct complex control flow using if-elif-else, while and for loops, mutable lists, and algorithmic problem solving.
• Module 4: Functions, Tuples, Dictionaries, Exceptions, and Data Processing — Build reusable, modular abstractions with parameter scoping, immutable tuples, key-value dictionaries, and defensive try-except blocks.

Upon completing all four modules and capstone projects, you will be prepared for the OpenEDG Python Institute PCEP-30-02 certification exam.

exercises.title: Hello NetAcad World
exercises.objective: Write and execute your inaugural Python program following clean formatting conventions.
exercises.description: Display an introductory multi-line greeting announcing your enrollment in Python Essentials 1.
instructions: Use the print() function to output 'I am learning Python Essentials 1 with Cisco NetAcad.'
Add a second print() statement displaying 'CareerTwin verified learner.'
hints: Strings in Python can be enclosed in double quotes or single quotes.
exercises.submissionRequirements: Submit code that prints both statements without syntax errors.
exercises.solutionExplanation:
print('I am learning Python Essentials 1 with Cisco NetAcad.')
print('CareerTwin verified learner.')
